---
Anyone signing in may create an organization, which lands it pending, and sees the welcome screen. Google sign-in is the waitlist form: the address is verified, there is no form backend and no spam, and enabling later is a flag flip on an account that already exists.

Do not show a queue position. It implies an ordering that will not be honored, because organizations are chosen deliberately. Do not promise an email unless SES is out of the sandbox; at this volume, mail the owner by hand when their organization is enabled.

**Done when:** a new person can sign in, create an organization, and see the welcome screen, and an operator sees it via the members CLI.
